versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-xhs-fetcher.
- Supports searching XiaoHongShu (小红书) public notes, fetching note details, retrieving comments, and scraping a creator’s public posts.
- Provides structured data for use cases like viral content mining, competitor analysis, KOL filtering, and comment insights.
- Command line tool with routing based on user input (keyword search, note URL, or creator profile URL).
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access; high volume (up to 10,000 results), safe (no login needed), and flexible filtering options.
- Includes thorough usage guidance, error handling, and best practices for robust data gathering.
